instruction_summary: Produce a calibrated, updated theory for AK91: promote the constant Mincer return to a time-varying skill price governed by a Katz-Murphy supply-demand law, calibrate paper-era vs 2026 parameters, decompose why the return rose/fell (demand vs supply), validate out-of-sample, and restate the QOB design under weak-IV-robust inference plus a modern instrument proposal.

steps.description: Read 001 deliverables (report, findings, result_card) and all 001 result CSVs/JSON; read replication codebase, provenance, and paper model section (Tables I, III-VI) from the PDF
steps.command: Read acs_ols_by_year.csv / lane_b_results.json / estimates_by_window.csv; pdftoppm paper pages

steps.description: Built a fresh Python venv (001's env was gone) and extracted paper-era schooling-supply moments from NEW7080.dta
Re-extracted 9 benchmark ACS 1-year years for men-40-49 schooling-supply moments, reusing 001's exact sample logic; every return check reproduces 001 to 4 decimals
Calibrated the supply-demand model, ran the race decomposition, the held-out OOS test, and the price x quantity inequality decomposition
Built the paper-era vs 2026 calibration table with epistemic labels
Produced the flagship 2-panel figure (skill price vs original model + held-out; race decomposition)
Wrote the theory section, report, and result card

key_results.model_update: rho_t = (1/sigma)(D_t - s_t): time-varying skill price via one added Katz-Murphy CES relative-demand equation; nests original as stationary-race constant-rho
key_results.decomp_2012_2024: supply drag -0.162 exceeds demand push +0.134 -> return falls (race turns)
key_results.weak_iv_restatement: AR 95% identified set [-0.002, 0.178] for 1930-39 cohort, first-stage F=4.75; point survives, sharp identification does not
key_results.instrument_proposal: college-margin discontinuities (aid/tuition/admission) or state 16->18 dropout-age changes, target F>>10; QOB exhausted (enrollment 0.97)

comparison_to_original.note: peak of the hump the model must fit
new supply moments driving the decomposition
new structural parameter of the updated model

deviations: sigma is CALIBRATED (=2.0), not structurally estimated: a short annual series with a narrow-sample supply proxy cannot pin the CES elasticity; robustness shown for sigma in {1.5,2.0,2.5} (all signs invariant), and sigma=2 is held-out-optimal.

Supply proxy is the men-40-49 sample's own college log-odds, not the economy-wide Autor-Katz-Krueger college-equivalent series; internally consistent but not a structural aggregate (aggregate SBTC narrative is PROPOSED/cite-level, as instructed).
2020 ACS 1-year PUMS does not exist (Census COVID gap, per 001); post-peak episode uses 2021-2024.
No new instrument was estimated; the 2026 design is a PROPOSED sketch (QOB unavailable in post-1980 public microdata).
Modest re-download: 9 ACS years re-fetched only for schooling-supply moments absent from 001; no original computation re-run (return checks confirm sample identity with 001).
